findings.description: The new `Amended by` link points to docs/adr/0127-the-complexity-stage-judges-a-new-file-on-its.md, which does not exist on this base commit or on the PR's tree, so the link is dead until PR #216 lands.
findings.body:
The new back-reference points to `docs/adr/0127-the-complexity-stage-judges-a-new-file-on-its.md`, which doesn't exist on this PR's tree or on `main`. ADR 0127 is only on PR #216 (`pup/t-mvphic87`), which is still **open**. Nothing else under `docs/adr` mentions `0127`.

The file name matches #216's file exactly, and that ADR does say `Amends: [0021]`, so the link and its direction are correct. The only problem is order: if this PR merges before #216, `main` carries a dead link in an accepted ADR. Merge this after #216, or fold the line into #216.

<https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/7bfc75852dce1890274b5eb1c8daadd145359e78/docs/adr/0021-debt-delta-three-soft-stages-with-a-merge.md#L4>
